integrity: Every length-2-through-14 word and internal cut tested by two independently written exact checkers; the recorded outputs alone are not a certificate without source replay.
scientific_limitations: Finite binary enumeration through length 14, not an asymptotic upper bound; the half-length ceiling is an explicit benchmark, not a known conjecture. Originality is best knowledge subject to unindexed earlier work. Independent audit not performed.
title: The first super-half cut density of maximal closed substrings in binary words
